arguments.description: OpenAI project the API key belongs to

commands.description:
Authenticate to OpenAI. 

Supports API key  autentication using the Git Credential Manager for storage.

Switch easily  between keys by just specifying the project name after initial login with  `--with-token`.

Alternatively, openai will use the authentication  token found in environment variables with the name  `OPENAI_API_KEY`.
This method is most suitable for  "headless" use such as in automation.

For example, to use openai in GitHub Actions, add `OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}` to "env".
